newsitem.title: INDIA: India castorseed futures dip ahead of new arrivals.
newsitem.headline: India castorseed futures dip ahead of new arrivals.

text.p: Castorseed December delivery fell to 1,099/1,100 rupees from 1,111/1,112 rupees per quintal on speculative selling on Tuesday, dealers said.
"There was little export demand," said a trader. "Bulls were liquidating long position ahead of new crop arrivals." He said new crop arrivals were expected to enter the market next month.
"Foreign buyers are demanding Indian castor oil at $675 per tonne while Indian offers are at $695," a dealer said.
Groundnut oil slipped to to 377/378 rupees per 10 kg from 382/383 rupees on new crop arrivals and lower than expected seasonal buying, traders said.

Arrivals from the Gujarat state were higher as Gujarat government had withdrawn restrictions on sale by Gujarat millers outside the state, traders said. In Rajkot spot oil was steady at 555 rupees per 15 kg.
